intro: Bans ragging in and outside educational institutions across Tamil Nadu. Overview of key points. National anti-ragging helpline: 1800-180-5522.

sections.p: Any disorderly conduct by words or acts — teasing, abusing, playing practical jokes or causing hurt — that causes physical or mental harm, fear, shame or embarrassment to a student, or makes them do something they wouldn't do willingly.
Ragging within or outside an educational institution is punishable.
sections.pen: Up to 2 years + fine up to ₹10,000

sections.p: A student convicted of ragging is dismissed from the institution and can't be admitted to any other educational institution in the state. Suspended students under investigation can also be kept out.
The head of the institution must act on complaints immediately — including suspending the accused and informing police. Failing to do so can lead to action against the head.
